title: Purpose before the day is spent
subtitle: A short return to the rare chance of this breath
description: A brief path for remembering that human life is not filler; it is a chance to meet the Lord while the body is still here.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The human body is given as a chance to meet Gobind, not as an ornament for distraction.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Spend one part of the day on meeting, remembrance, or service before maintenance consumes it.

evidence.coreClaim: This bundle restores urgency to the gift of human birth.
evidence.turn: Purpose becomes clear when the body is treated as an invitation, not a possession.
evidence.practicalImplication: Choose one embodied act that answers why this breath was given.
